research_question: Can the 44 annual characteristics that do not require industry adjustment, CPI, or market-value scaling be reconstructed from the extended annual source table?
timing_rule: Use the existing annual point-in-time assignment in the research master with no additional monthly lag.
orientation_rule: For each continuous feature compare only the published raw formula and its sign reversal on 2000-2009; select the orientation with positive and larger median monthly Spearman. Do not alter magnitudes or formulas. Discrete features are never sign-reversed.
stopping_rule: Judge each feature separately on 2010-2019. Failures require a source-backed later version; do not add formula candidates after confirmation.
